availableCommands.name: biome-worlds

Use when creating or fixing a Blender add-on, tool, or UI.

availableCommands.name: blender-animation
availableCommands.description: Animation in Blender 5.3 - slotted/layered actions and the channelbag API, Python keyframing, F-curves, game loops with pop/hitch checks, NLA clips, pose library, mocap/BVH/Mixamo retargeting with auto bone maps, baking control rigs to export skeletons, root motion, per-clip export. Use for any keyframe, action, NLA, mocap, or animation-export task.

availableCommands.name: blender-asset-qa
availableCommands.description: Mandatory review gate for any mesh or asset created or edited in Blender. Detects z-fighting, floating/detached parts, inverted or inconsistent normals, non-manifold/open geometry, degenerate faces, duplicate verts, n-gons, unapplied scale, UV problems, bad skin weights, material/texture errors, and renders multi-angle review sheets. Use before calling any modeling, export or delivery task done.

availableCommands.name: blender-character-rigging
availableCommands.description: Character rigging in Blender 5.3 - Rigify metarig fit/generate, bone naming/roll/collections, DEF/MCH/control layers, IK/FK, robust skinning (heat + proxy fallback), weight-painting rules, correctives, engine game skeletons (Unity, Unreal, Roblox R15), rig validation and deformation stress tests. Use for armature, skinning or weights tasks.

availableCommands.name: blender-clothing
availableCommands.description: Game clothing in Blender 5.3 - garments from body regions (ease offset, thickness), skin-weight transfer, hiding covered body faces, cloth-sim draping for folds, body-morph shape keys on garments, layered clothing, pose-aware poke-through checks, sim-to-game-mesh cleanup. Use for shirts, pants, armor, outfits, layered or swappable clothing.

availableCommands.name: blender-core
availableCommands.description: Foundation for any Blender 5.2+ task an agent drives - running bpy via MCP (live) or headless CLI, context overrides, locale-safe node lookup, enum discovery, 5.x API changes, verification. Use first for any Blender, bpy, .blend or 3D-asset request; routes to the specialized blender-* skills.

availableCommands.name: blender-environment-kits
availableCommands.description: Game environments in Blender 5.3 - terrain from noise or heightmaps (erosion, terraces, play areas, slope/height materials, 16-bit heightmaps + splat maps for UE/Unity), biome scatter by slope/height/mask with Poisson spacing, modular kit metrics and validation (grid, pivots, seams, texel density). Use for levels, landscapes, forests, modular buildings, dungeons.

availableCommands.name: blender-export-pipelines
availableCommands.description: Export from Blender 5.3 with verified presets - Roblox (FBX/glTF, cages, R15, SurfaceAppearance), Unity (FBX, Humanoid), Unreal (FBX skeletal, Nanite, UCX), Godot/web (GLB, meshopt/Draco, WebP), USD. Scale/axes, smoothing, tangents, leaf bones, clips, batch export, post-export verification. Use whenever an asset leaves Blender.

availableCommands.name: blender-facial-shapekeys
availableCommands.description: Facial rigs and shape keys in Blender 5.3 - ARKit 52 blendshapes, visemes for lip-sync, sculpting expressions, splitting symmetric shapes into Left/Right, mirroring, corrective and combination shapes, drivers and control rigs, bone+blendshape hybrids, export to engines (Unity, Unreal, Roblox dynamic heads, VRM/web). Use for faces, expressions, lip-sync, or any shape-key work.

availableCommands.name: blender-game-optimization
availableCommands.description: Optimize Blender assets for real-time engines - triangle/material/texture/bone budgets per platform (mobile, Roblox, web, VR, console, PC), LOD chains, decimation modes, mesh cleanup, draw-call reduction (material merging, atlases, trim sheets), instancing, vertex-split costs, collision proxies, texture memory. Use when an asset is too heavy, before export, or when targeting a platform budget.

availableCommands.name: blender-geometry-nodes
availableCommands.description: Geometry Nodes in Blender 5.3 - fields, domains, attributes, instancing, zones (simulation/repeat/for-each), closures/bundles, lists, SDF grids, node tools, baking, plus a JSON-to-node-tree builder and socket inspector. Use for scattering, procedural assets/environments, parametric tools and modifier inputs.

availableCommands.name: blender-hair-grooming
availableCommands.description: Hair and fur in Blender 5.3 - hair curves on a surface, guides + interpolated children with the bundled hair node assets (clump, curl, noise, droop), density masks, Principled Hair BSDF (melanin), Curves Sculpt combing, 5.2 node Hair Dynamics, game hair cards with a rendered strand atlas, Alembic/USD groom export. Use for hair, fur, beards, eyebrows, grass tufts.

availableCommands.name: blender-hardsurface-modeling
availableCommands.description: Hard-surface and prop modeling in Blender 5.3 - blockout-to-detail flow, non-destructive modifier stacks (Mirror, Boolean Exact/Manifold, Bevel, Weighted Normal, Smooth by Angle), mid-poly vs subdivision vs high-to-low workflows, shading/custom normals, cylinder segment budgets, edge attributes from Python. Use for weapons, vehicles, props, architecture, mechanical parts.

availableCommands.name: blender-lighting-lookdev
availableCommands.description: Lighting, cameras and look-dev in Blender 5.3 - studio 3-point and product lighting, HDRI environments, sun/sky exteriors, interiors, light linking, physically based light units, camera focal lengths/composition/DOF, cyclorama backdrops, looping turntables for asset presentation. Use when presenting assets, setting up scenes for rendering, or judging materials under consistent light.

availableCommands.name: blender-modeler
availableCommands.description: Core Blender modeling specialist for Edit Mode, modifiers, collections, precision modeling, and scene organization. Use for general 3D modeling, blockouts, cleanup, non-destructive workflows, and scene structure in Blender via MCP.

availableCommands.name: blender-pbr-materials
availableCommands.description: Physically based materials in Blender 5.3 - metal/roughness rules, Principled BSDF inputs, color spaces (sRGB vs Non-Color), measured albedo/F0 values, texture-set auto-wiring, ORM channel packing, DirectX vs OpenGL normals, alpha modes, displacement, view transforms (AgX, Khronos PBR Neutral), engine-ready material rules. Use when creating, fixing, or exporting materials and textures.

availableCommands.name: blender-pipeline-automation
availableCommands.description: Automate Blender 5.3 at scale - headless CLI flags, batch convert/inventory/run-any-skill-script over folders of .blend/.fbx/.glb/.obj/.usd, sharding, bpy pip module, library linking, path management, render-farm and CI patterns. Use for batch jobs, format conversion, library maintenance and pipeline tooling.

availableCommands.name: blender-rendering
availableCommands.description: Render with Blender 5.3 Cycles/EEVEE/Workbench - quality presets, GPU setup, adaptive sampling, denoising, light paths, color management (AgX, Khronos PBR Neutral, ACES), PNG/EXR/MP4 output, passes, the 5.0 compositor API, CLI and multi-camera batch rendering. Use for any still, animation or turntable render.

availableCommands.name: blender-retopology-uv
availableCommands.description: Retopology and UVs in Blender 5.3 - auto retopo (Quadriflow, Decimate, planar), deformation edge flow, seams, unwrap (Angle Based, Minimum Stretch, Smart), pixel-margin packing, texel density measure/set, lightmap UV2, UDIMs, mirrored UVs. availableCommands.name: blender-scene-setup

Use when starting a project, organizing a .blend, or before handoff/export.

availableCommands.name: blender-sculpting
availableCommands.description: Sculpting in Blender 5.3 - base-to-detail workflow, voxel remesh, dyntopo, multires, 5.x brush types, masks/face sets, symmetry, plus headless-safe procedural ops for agents (remesh, symmetrize, multires, inflate, noise detail, smooth) and the sculpt-to-game handoff. Use for organic models, characters, creatures, rocks and bake sources.

availableCommands.name: blender-simulation
availableCommands.description: Physics in Blender 5.3 - rigid bodies (density mass, shapes, bake to keys), classic cloth presets and pinning, new node-based Cloth/Hair Dynamics (XPBD, Collider, effectors), Mantaflow fluids, hair curves, GN simulation zones, headless baking. Use for destruction, drapes, flags, falling objects, liquids, smoke, hair motion.

availableCommands.name: blender-stylized-npr
availableCommands.description: Stylized / NPR looks in Blender 5.3 - toon and cel shading (bands, shadow tint, rim, hard specular), anime faces with custom normals, inverted-hull outlines with smoothed outline normals for game engines, Line Art and Freestyle lines, Grease Pencil drawing, unlit export. Use for anime, cartoon, comic, cel-shaded or outlined styles.

availableCommands.name: blender-texture-baking
availableCommands.description: Bake texture maps in Blender 5.3 Cycles - high-to-low normal maps with cage/extrusion, AO, curvature, ID, thickness, base color/roughness/metallic from procedurals, ORM packing, OpenGL vs DirectX, margins, GPU baking, fixing skewing/waviness/seams. Use when transferring sculpt or high-poly detail to game meshes or converting procedural materials to textures.

availableCommands.name: blender-texturing
availableCommands.description: Texture authoring in Blender 5.3 - smart-material layers (edge wear, cavity grime, dust, rust, roughness breakup) from curvature/AO masks, z-fight-safe decal and sticker placement, trim sheets, tiling + vertex-color blends, texture painting, baking the look to game texture sets. Use when a material needs wear, dirt, a decal, trims or hand painting, not just wiring.

availableCommands.name: blender-time-of-day
availableCommands.description: Time of day and atmosphere in Blender 5.3 - measured sky + sun for dawn, morning, noon, golden hour, sunset, blue hour, overcast, night/moonlight with stars and city glow, exposure balance, height fog from visibility, god rays, Cycles vs EEVEE volumes, compositor grade, stylized moods (cyberpunk neon, horror, underwater, desert). availableCommands.name: blender-video-editing
